叶清秋将尸体处理了，从山洞中出来，神色阴沉的往山下走，完全没注意到山洞外面站了两个人。

她和这个魔族订下契约是在五年前，那个时候她得罪了几个人，被追杀到一处悬崖，迫不得已跳了下去，在她完全不知道的情况下，就和这个魔族订下了契约。

等她醒过来已经晚了，要摆脱这个魔族，就必须让他恢复肉身。

但是他恢复肉身需要水灵根的女修，第一个遭殃的就是她，因为她和他是契约关系，她才没有变成干尸。

但是那种感觉她绝对不想经历第二遍，所以她不得不找其他水灵根的女修。

如果是在剧情中，叶清秋有宗主庇佑，一帆风顺，她不会掉下悬崖，不会遇到这个魔族，自然不会经历这些。

时笙自然不知这些，她就算知道，也只会感叹一声，造化弄人，当初原主在魔族经历的，那才是生不如死。

叶清秋这点，连开胃菜都算不上。

第二天时笙到大比现场的时候，发现那些人竟然激动得跟吃了炫迈似的，看到她都没有之前那么害怕了。

甚至是还有露出幸灾乐祸的表情，似乎在等着她倒霉。

一个晚上，发生了神马？

干了坏事的不是叶清秋吗？为毛用这种眼神看本宝宝啊！！

“妖女，我们掌门请你过去！”

几个桐山派的弟子突然拦在时笙面前，话刚说完，几个人就飞了出去，砸在远处的小树林中，惊起好几只飞鸟。

四周一片静默。

时笙扭头看凤辞。

好好的，你打人家做什么？

凤辞呆萌的眨了眨眼，一本正经的道：“我没杀他。”

时笙：“……”你是没杀他，估计这下子得在床上躺个半年。

算了，和反派讲什么道理啊！

不过好好的桐山派掌门请她做什么？难不成昨晚的事被发现了，叶清秋把罪名推到了她身上？

事实证明时笙脑洞开太大，掌门请他跟叶清秋一点关系都没有，而是——和男主有关。

仙界来人了！

仙界来人了！

和第一次见面的狼狈不同，此时的龙玦看上非常有男神范儿，衣冠楚楚，相貌堂堂，丰神俊朗，属于那种看哪儿哪儿都帅的男神。

龙玦深幽的目光从时笙身上扫过，落在凤辞身上。

Ye Qingqiu disposed of the body, came out of the cave, and walked down the mountain with a gloomy expression, completely unaware of the two people standing outside the cave.

She made a contract with this demon five years ago. At that time, she offended several people and was chased to a cliff. She had no choice but to jump off. Without her knowing it, she made a contract with this demon.

By the time she woke up, it was already too late. To get rid of this demon, she had to restore his body.

But the female cultivator who needed the water spirit root to restore his body was the first to suffer. Because she had a contractual relationship with him, she did not become a mummy.

But she definitely didn't want to experience that feeling again, so she had to find another female cultivator with water spirit roots.

If in the plot, Ye Qingqiu had the protection of the sect master and everything was smooth sailing, she would not fall off the cliff, meet this demon clan, and naturally would not experience this.

Naturally, Shi Sheng didn't know this. Even if she knew, she would only sigh, fate plays tricks on people, and what the original owner experienced in the demon clan was life worse than death.

Ye Qingqiu is not even an appetizer.

When Shi Sheng arrived at the competition site the next day, she found that the people were as excited as if they had eaten Xuanmai, and they were not as scared as before when they saw her.

He even showed a gloating expression, as if he was waiting for her to be unlucky.

One night, something strange happened?

Wasn't it Ye Qingqiu who did the bad thing?Why is Mao looking at this baby like this!!

"Witch, our leader invites you to come over!"

Several disciples of the Tongshan sect suddenly stopped in front of Shi Sheng. As soon as he finished speaking, several of them flew out and crashed into the woods in the distance, startling several birds.

There was silence.

Shi Sheng turned to look at Feng Ci.

Okay, what are you doing to hit someone?

Feng Ci blinked cutely and said seriously: "I didn't kill him."

Shi Sheng: "..." If you didn't kill him, I guess he would have to lie in bed for half a year.

Forget it, what's the point of talking to the villain?

But what did the leader of the Kiriyama faction ask her to do?Could it be that what happened last night was discovered and Ye Qingqiu put the blame on her?

It turned out that Shi Sheng was too imaginative. The boss' invitation to him had nothing to do with Ye Qingqiu, but - to do with the male protagonist.

Someone from the fairy world is coming!

Someone from the fairy world is coming!

Different from the embarrassment when they first met, Long Jue at this time looked very much like a male god. He was well-dressed, handsome, and handsome. He was the kind of male god who looked handsome everywhere.

Long Jue's deep gaze swept across Shi Sheng and landed on Feng Ci.
